root_idea.summary: The root's central orientation is waiting in expectation.
root_idea.development: The lexical field develops from remaining in expectancy to awaiting an event or its outcome. Related forms name the state or period of waiting, being placed in expectation, and— in broader Classical usage—holding goods while awaiting a favorable price.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form V perfect citation form.
Displayed under the normalized singular active-participle citation form.

senses.definition: To wait for, await, or expect a thing, event, or outcome.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, this includes remaining through an appointed waiting period and awaiting what will befall oneself or another, whether favorable or adverse. The construction may take بِـ with the awaited person or thing, or a direct object.

senses.definition: One who waits for, awaits, or expects a thing, event, or outcome.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle from تَرَبَّصَ; the Quranic occurrences describe persons waiting in expectation of an outcome or event.
Denotes the act or state of waiting, including waiting through a specified period or for an event or outcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put someone in expectation; to make a person await a thing, affair, or event.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction رَبَصَنِي الشيءُ, in which the thing or event places the person in expectation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wait for a favorable market price for a commodity, especially a time of high prices.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A commercial usage involving delaying disposition of goods while awaiting a rise or other favorable change in price.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state, period, or occasion of waiting or expectancy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe tarrying in expectation concerning goods, a place, or an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A term granted to a husband judged incapable of sexual intercourse with his wife, after which separation occurs if he does not resume marital relations.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical Arabic marital and legal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Placed in expectation or kept waiting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a person who has been put into a state of expectation; the source illustration does not restrict the meaning to a particular gender.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who withholds or stockpiles wheat or similar goods while waiting for a time of high prices; a hoarder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized commercial usage involving withholding goods from the market.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only cross-reference to the Form V entry.
Form I construction meaning to put someone in expectation.
Waiting or expecting an event, including the Quran-attested construction, plus commercial waiting for dearness.
The noun for a state or period of waiting.
Passive participle meaning placed in expectation.
Commercial active-participle specialization for one who withholds goods.

cautions: The active participle is presented under the singular citation form مُتَرَبِّص although the Quranic attestations include plural and singular inflections.
The market-hoarding and specialized marital-term meanings are broader Classical Arabic usages and are kept separate from the Quranic waiting senses.
